author: Inside Edition
description: A man got the shock of his life when he opened his garage door and was met with police pointing guns at him and ordering him to put up his hands. They accused him of fleeing an officer who was trying to pull him over. Kevin Finley spent nearly two years trying to show that he was innocent. His defense got a big lift from dashcam footage recorded by his Tesla and  Finley was acquitted. He has filed an official complaint against the police. The department did not return Inside Edition's calls for comment.
title: Tesla Dashcam Helps Florida Man Beat Traffic Rap

author: Inside Edition
description: Selena Gomez has a serious message: don't vape. The 34-year-old singer took to social media to share that she regrets her years vaping nicotine. She says it's changed her singing voice. The "Only Murders in the Building" star's words come at an opportune time – a new study from the Medical University of South Carolina finds that young girls are vaping more than boys. Inside Edition's Alison Hall reports.
title: Selena Gomez Says She Regrets Vaping

author: Inside Edition
description: An airline passenger allegedly burst into tears – for three hours. According to travel blogger Tomiko Harvey, the woman sitting next to her wanted her aisle seat. When Harvey refused, her seatmate proceeded to weep. The woman wanted Harvey to switch seats with her husband, who was in a middle seat three rows up on a 10-hour flight. The woman wanted her husband to sit next to her, so she could rest her head on his shoulder, Harvey said in a video post, which has gone viral with nearly 5 million views.
title: Why Is This Woman Sobbing During A Flight?

author: Inside Edition
description: The new movie "Whalefall" is about a young diver who is swallowed by a whale and spends the entire movie trying to escape before his oxygen runs out. The plot seems far-fetched, but it actually happened to Michael Packard. He was swallowed by a humpback whale in 2021 while diving for lobsters off the coast of Cape Cod. Packard's story was met with skepticism, Inside Edition previously reported. Now, Packard shared his thoughts on the new movie.
title: Man Who Was Actually Swallowed By Whale Reacts To New 'Whalefall' Movie

author: Inside Edition
description: North Korean state media has reportedly released new photos of Kim Jong Un after recent death rumors circulated. The photos show Kim and his daughter touring a clothing and shoe expo, however media outlets outside the country say they cannot confirm when the photos were taken. Speculation of his death was reportedly sparked by a Chinese dissident who posted on social media that Kim fell into a coma and died at a hospital in Beijing. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: North Korea Releases Photos Of Kim Jong Un After Death Rumors Circulate

author: Inside Edition
description: A priest was killed by a falling cross as he stood at the altar celebrating Mass. Worshippers rushed to help him in a ceremony that was being livestreamed on social media Saturday from a Catholic church in Ecuador. Father Patricio Sánchez of Perpetuo Socorro Church in Guayaquil was leading the service when a giant crucifix broke from a wall and crashed onto him, to the horror of witnesses. Father Sánchez died of his injuries that same day. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Priest Killed During Mass When Giant Crucifix Falls On Him

author: Inside Edition
description: While protests continue across France, surveillance footage from a jewelry shop in Lyon shows looters busting into a jewelry store. With their faces covers, multiple looters are seen smashing the windows of Koumal Jewelry, ripping open drawers, destroying display cases and pocketing jewels. It's not known how many items were stolen, or their total value. Residents across France are worried about how destroyed business will recover during the violent demonstrations.
title: Surveillance Cameras Capture Jewelry Store Being Looted During French Protests

author: Inside Edition
description: A prowler was on the loose in California, but it wasn't very discreet. The Santa Cruz County Sheriff's Office said deputies had a busy night chasing an emu around a residential neighborhood. They released a video of the chase on social media saying, "apparently “keeping the peace” sometimes translates to keeping an emu out of traffic long enough for its owner to come get it." Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Sheriff's Deputies Chase Runaway Emu Through Streets

author: Inside Edition
description: After fraternity hazing tragedies killed their teenage sons, three sets of parents sat down with Inside Edition to talk about their fight for justice, which is the subject of a new documentary called "4000 Days."
title: Fraternity Hazing Tragedies Push Parents To Fight For Justice
